method: Raw 11 decision bits plus documented fixed capacitance-derived reconstruction, explicitly permitted by SAR_SPEC interface. No tone, code fit or per-corner calibration.
output: q=1023.5 + normalization*sum((2*D_i-1)*weight_i); fractional or rounded11-bit derived outputs reported separately.
scope: Frozen single decoder for all three physical corners; conversion window/power unchanged. C20G reconstruction is a late deterministic control after its raw spectra were known; coefficients still use physical data alone.
